summary_5_lines: Business: Platter House Restaurant, Mardan — a BBQ platter restaurant on Nowshera Road (Pull, near Ring Road), rated 4.1 from 1,400+ Google reviews, open daily 9 AM – 11 PM, with no own website (TikTok @platterhousemardan only).

Why chosen: a well-reviewed, family-favourite BBQ house whose signature is mixed platters served sizzling on coal burners, with no website to compete against — a strong demo candidate, built for the main Nowshera Road branch only.

Design direction: full-bleed cinematic with a coal-burner BBQ platter hero, near-black #1A1512 base, ember red #B3372A accent and bone #F4EDE1, Bowlby One display type with Encode Sans body — bold, smoky, built for sharing.
Signature elements: ember marquee of house dishes, menu-board platter cards, a horizontal-scroll BBQ & Grill rail, a three-step Coal Fire process section, and a lightbox gallery.

Could not be verified: founding year/history, individual dish prices (site says 'Prices on request' once), delivery/takeaway, seating capacity, verbatim Google review quotes, a real logo (text wordmark used), and Branch 2 / Platter House 03 details (excluded, recorded in research.json).
